subject: Post-call recap: Integration & product fit (SDK, streaming, function-calling, embeddings)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Integration & product fit (SDK, streaming, function-calling, embeddings)

Alex  thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned.

Key pain points you shared:
- Latency/spikiness on streaming responses is interfering with your real-time support use case.
- Difficulty getting consistent structured outputs from the model for downstream systems (order extraction / entity mapping).
- Current embedding pipeline struggles with reranking relevance for short text queries.

What we discussed as goals:
- Low-latency streaming for agent-facing UI (sub-200ms token latency objective).
- Deterministic structured outputs via function-calling / structured response enforcement for extraction flows.
- Improved embedding/re-ranking accuracy for short queries with an evaluation harness and A/B.

Fit / integration notes from the call:
- SDK: you'd prefer minimal changes to your current client; Connor will propose a sample client patch that shows streaming + function-calling in ~10 LOC.
- Function calling: Redwood's structured output mode + function-call metadata should let you enforce schema and reduce post-processing logic.
- Streaming: we can route your traffic to a dedicated pool (Dedicated) for predictable latency; we also suggested prefix/KV caching to reduce token work for repeated prompts.
- Embeddings / reranking: propose running a small evaluation (500 queries) using our embeddings variants + distance metrics to identify lift; reranking can be implemented in our SDK as a comparator hook or done server-side.

Immediate next steps (owner):
- Connor: share SDK patch + minimal repro (by Fri 3/6).
- Marissa: send MAP + SOW draft for procurement review (today).
- Alex: confirm two times for a technical demo next week (see proposed below).

Proposed demo slots:
- Tue 3/10 10:0010:30 PT
- Wed 3/11 14:0014:30 PT

Attachments: MAP_Acme.pdf (mutual action plan), SOW_draft.docx (draft scope & pricing)

Thanks  I'll follow up with Connor's notes and a calendar invite once Alex confirms a slot.
—
Marissa Cole

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Integration & product fit (SDK, streaming, function-calling, embeddings)
\Alex  quick tech note from our side (assembling a short repro now).
\SDK changes (high level):
- Client-side: add stream handler and function-call callback (~812 lines). We'll provide a single file patch you can drop into your existing client.
- Server-side: no changes required if you call the streaming endpoint; we can toggle structured output enforcement via the model config.
\Example (pseudo):
- stream = client.generate_stream(prompt, on_token=append_to_ui)
- result = client.call_function("extract_order", schema=my_schema)
\Function calling notes:
- We enforce schema at the model layer; when invoked, the model returns a typed payload you can map directly to your extraction logic. That eliminates brittle regex parsing.
- For edge cases, we include a confidence score and the raw text back to allow fallback heuristics.
\Streaming / latency:
- For sub-200ms token latency we recommend dedicated GPU pool + small sequence batching (14). We can also enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts (support agent templates).
\Embeddings / reranking plan:
- Send a redacted sample of 500 queries + expected relevance. We'll run three embedding variants and provide re-ranking lift and token/cost estimates.
\I'll attach the patch and a README in the follow-up email (small zip).
—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
